# Instructions for GitHub Copilot: Locker Notes

Read `NOTES.md` in the repo root first. It explains the files, how the AI Teacher works, and the project rules.

Key rules:
- Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript only. No frameworks, build tools or new libraries unless the owner asks.
- `data.js` holds all the content and loads before `index.js` / `class.js`.
- Never put API keys or passwords in any file.
- This site is for school students: simple, friendly, safe language.
- Make one small change at a time. Don't rename element ids or functions used by `onclick` in the HTML.
- When you add, rename or delete a site file, update `ASSETS` and `CACHE_NAME` in `sw.js`.
